ai.title: Fix gitignore pattern rebasing in file tree
ai.summary: Refactored `parseGitignore` in `common/src/project-file-tree.ts` to use a new `rebaseGitignorePattern` helper. This correctly handles recursive pattern semantics (e.g. `logs` -> `base/**/logs`) and anchored patterns (e.g. `/foo` -> `base/foo`) relative to the project root, fixing previous issues where nested `.gitignore` files were not respected in the file tree.

eli5.text: Projects with sub-folders that each have their own ignore-lists now respect those lists correctly. Previously, a rule like "logs" in a sub-folder's list only applied to that one folder, so matching folders elsewhere were still shown; now such a rule correctly hides matching folders in that sub-folder and anywhere deeper inside it, and anchored rules (starting with a slash) are pinned to the right place. This only affects the built list of project files you see when the system scans a project's structure, so the file tree you're shown will now hide the things those nested ignore-lists actually meant to hide. It's live today.

eli5.text: The backend service used to shut itself all the way down whenever it hit an unexpected error, which meant users could lose access until someone restarted it. If you were watching the logs, you would still see the errors recorded, but the service itself would stay up instead of requiring a manual restart. This change is live today.

Now those readings have a simple default value so each page always has something safe to work with, even while it's still loading. You won't see anything new on the pages, but the fix helps prevent error messages or blank spots from appearing for people moving through the admin, organization, billing, and docs sections of the app.

ai.title: Fix streaming text deduplication in CLI and SDK
ai.summary: Streaming text now deduplicates correctly in CLI and SDK using a new mergeTextSegments function and shared tool-xml-filter module. Previous logic failed to handle overlapping chunks or full replacements, causing duplicated or missing text in agent responses. Changes affect cli/src/hooks/use-send-message.ts and sdk/src/run.ts, with logic extracted to sdk/src/tool-xml-filter.ts. The update introduces root stream buffering and agent-specific accumulators to maintain state across chunks.

eli5.text: When you ask the assistant a question and it answers bit by bit, the words sometimes showed up twice on your screen, or a chunk of the reply went missing mid-sentence. The fix introduces a smarter way to stitch each incoming fragment to what was already shown, so now what you see builds up one smooth, correct sentence at a time, with no repeats or gaps. It's live today in both the command-line tool and the SDK that powers it. If you watch a streamed response now, you'll notice the text grows steadily without the earlier jumps or duplications.
